title.narrative: Integrated, multi-stakeholder approach for pipeline development (GCF Readiness)

description.narrative: The principal goal of this Readiness proposal is to significantly improve Kiribati's capacity to effectively access critical climate finance and ensure successful engagement with the Green Climate Fund through the project pipeline . This overarching goal is pursued through four distinct, interconnected objectives . The first is to build and strengthen essential human, technical, and institutional capacity across all relevant sectors to undertake climate mandates . Second, the project aims to strengthen and ensure the effectiveness of internal coordination and communication mechanisms among ministries and stakeholders to reduce duplication and improve climate planning . Third, it seeks to develop and implement necessary climate finance strategies and plans, including no objection procedures and the Country Programme . Finally, the project will specifically support the Ministry of Finance and Economic Development to strengthen its policies and procedures for GCF Financial Management Capacity Assessment re-accreditation, thereby ensuring a strong and viable national delivery partner .

This Readiness grant is a 24-month project designed to facilitate the Republic of Kiribati's ability to strengthen long-term low-emission, climate-resilient development . The core of the project involves building human, technical, and institutional capacity within the National Designated Authority Office, government, private sector, and civil society . It focuses on improving the country's capacity to access and successfully engage with the Green Climate Fund through a dedicated project pipeline development process . Key activities include strengthening internal coordination, developing climate finance-related strategies such as no objection procedures and the Country Programme, and supporting the Ministry of Finance and Economic Development in its Financial Management Capacity Assessment re-accreditation .
